home: Fourteen mountains on earth rise above eight thousand metres. Standing on top of all of them is not principally a feat of strength. It is preparation, timing, judgment, and the willingness to turn back, repeated over years, in conditions that forgive nothing.

Company-building works the same way. Not one summit but a sequence of them, each demanding a different route, a different team, a different appetite for risk. By the time the last hundred metres are in view, the outcome has usually been decided by choices made much lower down. We invest in those choices, and we stay on the rope for the way down as well as the way up.

14Peaks Capital is an early-stage venture capital firm headquartered in Switzerland, with offices in the United States, partnering with companies in the financial services technology and fintech sector across Europe and the United States, from pre-seed to series A. We back founders building scalable technology that changes how financial services work, from industry-specific infrastructure to cross-sector fintech applications. We partner with founders early and aim to be a catalyst for their growth through an active, hands-on approach.

home: building companies from breakthrough technologies
The journey from scientific discovery to a company that changes an industry is rarely straightforward—and rarely funded.

Over the next decade, the most important companies will emerge from advances in biology, materials, and computation. Yet the system to translate these breakthroughs is broken. Most capital arrives too late, and most institutions are not built to commercialize foundational science.
1955 Capital focuses on this translational gap —investing before markets are obvious and working closely with founders, scientists, and innovators to turn early discoveries into real companies.

Led by Andrew Chung, formerly General Partner at Khosla Ventures and investor at Lightspeed Ventures, the firm was founded in 2016 on the conviction that the defining companies of the next era are being created today—often from science that traditional investors overlook.

We partner from the earliest stages to shape technology, build teams, and accelerate the path from lab to scale. This thesis-driven, operator-led approach has led to top-quartile performance since inception and partnerships with leading global investors.

Transforming how energy and industrial systems are built and operated. We invest across power, infrastructure, and materials—enabling more efficient, scalable, and resilient systems, from next-generation batteries to industrial processes.

Advancing the next generation of biological and health platforms. We focus on diagnostics, therapeutics, and programmable biology—enabling earlier detection, more precise treatments, and entirely new capabilities in human health.

Feeding the world sustainably requires rethinking how food and resources are produced at scale. We invest in foundational technologies—from alternative proteins to agricultural systems and water infrastructure—that enable more resilient global supply chains.
Applying advances in computation to real-world systems. We back AI, robotics, and data-driven platforms that unlock new capabilities across physical and biological domains.

home: Making trust instant, open and programmable
A research-driven global investment firm since 2018
We founded 1kx in 2018 on a structural claim: trust was about to become contestable, and the largest outcomes in technology would accrue to the networks and companies that compressed its cost.

Eight years, three market cycles, and more than 160 investments later, that claim has held. Decentralized finance, stablecoin payments, and the protocols beneath them produced the outcomes our 2018 thesis predicted. The data has sharpened the framework: Cost of Trust 2.0 names the two mechanisms by which the prize is captured.

What hasn't changed is how we work. We underwrite on fundamentals. We commit across cycles. We partner with founders building configurations that compound: the ones that require a blockchain to exist.
Backing the networks and companies that lower the cost of trust.
Cost of Trust 2.0 Flagship thesis, June 2026
Roughly 35% of the US labor market is trust-enabling work: auditors, escrow agents, intermediaries, paperwork.
Blockchain reduces the cost of establishing that trust toward zero.
Cost of Trust 1.0 named the addressable surface. 2.0 names the two mechanisms by which it is captured.

about: 415 Capital is a specialist venture capital firm dedicated to investing in breakthrough and life-saving medical innovation. home: 7-Ventures, LLC, is the 7-Eleven ® corporate venture arm focused on discovering, partnering, and investing in startups that complement the 7-Eleven mission of convenience.
7-Ventures invests and partners with Food and Beverage CPG brands, Innovative Convenience Services, and Emerging Retail Technology to anticipate and respond to the ever-changing consumer demands.
7-Eleven has a legacy of innovation, and we are continuing that tradition by learning about and backing the technologies, services, and products that will redefine the industry.
We experiment and analyze, and we do it quickly. Moving fast allows 7-Eleven and the entrepreneurs who work with us to explore the marketplace and define success.
We are seeking the newest and best in convenience because that is what our customers expect. We love helping our partners because, in the end, it helps us better serve our customers.

We are not only your corner store, we are a global brand. 7-Eleven—the world’s largest convenience retailer—operates, franchises, or licenses more than 80,000 stores around the world, serving 65 million customers daily. In North America, 7-Eleven has 13,000 stores with the acquisition of Speedway and Stripes, serving 12 million customers daily, and we are present in 47 of the 50 most populated metro areas.

7-Eleven has pioneered innovation since 1927, resulting in a rich history of industry firsts. We introduced the industry to pre-paid phone cards and ATM services. We were the first company to operate 24/7, serve to-go coffee, and offer self-serve fountain soda, as well as the first to make a commercial drone delivery to a customer in the U.S. After 90 years, we have no intention of stopping there – we continue to be customer-obsessed and provide innovative products and experiences.

7-Ventures is focused on learning about new products, services, transformational business models, and processes that can create marketplace disruptions and empower 7-Eleven core business with unique strategic levers for not only sustainability, but also accelerated growth. Our current areas of interest include CPG products, in-store services, and retail technology.

Our comprehensive enterprise support structure is a hands-on approach to partnership, offering guidance with commercial distribution, operations support, product development, marketing, insights, and analytics. Working together gives early-stage businesses unparalleled access to 7-Eleven infrastructure and a lasting, strategic partnership.
7-Ventures does not disclose active investments

Abingworth has raised 15 funds dedicated to investing in life sciences and healthcare.

home: Since our first biotech investment nearly forty years ago, Abingworth has helped young biopharma companies on both sides of the Atlantic turn the latest scientific discoveries into dozens of new treatments for patients.

That process requires time, patience, determination, experience and capital—all of which we provide to our portfolio companies. As the pace of life science research continues to increase, so does the flow of discoveries with the potential to yield new therapeutics. We look forward to working with the next generation of biopharma companies to convert that potential into reality.

1987. That’s when Abingworth made its first investment in a biotech startup. In the decades since, we’ve invested in more than a hundred young companies. Along the way, we’ve helped entrepreneurs navigate through almost every conceivable scenario, good and bad, boom and bust. That’s taught us a lot about building successful companies—experience we love to share with the teams in our portfolio companies.

Innovation is of course the hallmark of the companies in which we invest, but also of Abingworth itself. To prosper as long as we have in the sometimes-precarious world of life-science investing, we have developed our own novel approaches to augment the early-stage investing that has always been at the heart of our strategy.
Examples include our pioneering work with “VIPEs” (Venture Investments in Public Equities) and Clinical Co-Development.
With offices in London, New York and San Francisco we are plugged into new developments—and easily accessible to entrepreneurs—in the key biotech hubs on both sides of the Atlantic.

home: Bookstores, Tea Shops & Museums: Romantic Places for Quiet Souls

In a world that often equates romance with noise, spectacle, and grand gestures, quiet souls crave something else—depth, comfort, and intimacy that doesn’t have to shout to be heard. For those who value reflection over flash and substance over stimulation, the most romantic places are often the simplest: a tucked-away bookstore, a softly lit tea shop, or the still corridors of a museum. These spaces invite a different kind of connection—one that grows in silence, observation, and shared appreciation.
Bookstores: The Romance of Shared Curiosity

There’s something quietly intimate about wandering through a bookstore with someone you’re getting to know. You don’t have to maintain eye contact the entire time, and the natural pauses between shelves give both people a chance to breathe. You can explore side by side, occasionally exchanging a title, a quote, or a memory triggered by a book’s cover. The interaction is low-pressure but meaningful.

Bookstores also reveal a person’s inner world. What they’re drawn to, what they linger on, what they put back without a word—all of it speaks. You learn more about each other through shared silences than you might in an hour of conversation in a loud bar. And when you do speak, the topics are naturally more personal, shaped by ideas and stories rather than surface-level questions.

Ending the outing with a quiet coffee or tea while flipping through your finds only deepens the experience. It’s not just about reading—it’s about showing someone what draws you in and letting them do the same.
Tea Shops: Soft Spaces for Gentle Conversation

Unlike the clatter and chaos of trendy cafés or nightspots, tea shops offer a softer alternative. The lighting is dimmer, the music quieter, and the atmosphere more intentional. Everything slows down in a tea shop—from the way drinks are poured to the way conversations unfold. There’s space to sit close without shouting, to sip slowly, to hold a moment a little longer than usual.

This kind of environment helps sensitive people stay connected to themselves and each other. You’re not overwhelmed by external noise, so you can focus on the small cues—how someone looks at you when you’re speaking, how your energies settle into a shared rhythm. A date here isn’t about making an impression. It’s about offering presence.

Choosing a tea based on mood, sharing a pot instead of ordering separately, or just sitting in companionable quiet all say something meaningful. These small rituals create safety and warmth, which allows vulnerability to emerge naturally—not forced, but welcomed.

home: AI Grant - accelerator for seed-stage AI startups
What type of company or project qualifies?

Anything that leverages AI models in a useful or engaging way. In particular, we're looking for technical & pragmatic founders who want to build great products. If you get a thrill from making something that other people love to use, and you understand that building a new product is 1% idea and 99% iteration, we want to support you. Our focus with AI Grant is on pre-seed/seed-stage startups.

It is an investment. When we started AI Grant in 2017, we handed out much smaller grants for fundamental research. We awarded grants to 36 individuals , who went on to do important research, and to found companies like Cohere , Helia , and Cresta .

Five years later, it seems much has changed: AI research is abundant, but UX and product innovation is just getting started, and so we're relaunching the program with a focus on AI products & investments versus AI papers & grants.
AI Grant is run by Hersh Desai and Lenny Bogdonoff . Nat and Daniel have invested $10M in AI Grant. The company investments themselves are made by AI Grant LLC.
Will you fund multiple projects working on the same thing?

Yes. We plan to fund many companies; some form of overlap is bound to happen. Ultimately, we don't think this will be an issue because we strongly believe the AI product market is enormous -- large enough to support both Lyft and Uber or Bing and Google.

We're looking for smart and energetic people with actionable ideas that are clearly useful. Demos are a big plus; not just because they're fun to look at, but because they hint at the type of person that cares about the end-user experience, which is ultimately all that matters.

As in previous technological revolutions, alongside opportunity come strategic risks. Les discussions lors des due diligences puis les négociations menées par les équipes du fonds ont été remarquablement fluides et transparentes. Pour un fondateur en phase d’amorçage, c'est non seulement agréable, mais aussi extrêmement rassurant. Cette approche a immédiatement créé une proximité et une confiance qui perdurent dans notre collaboration quotidienne avec Aquiti.

Aquiti reste historiquement le partenaire « fil rouge » du groupe Talis. Et marque ainsi sa confiance en notre réseau. Leur présence à nos côtés est un gage de stabilité. Nous partageons les mêmes valeurs en matière d’engagement.

Dès les prémices de notre projet l’équipe d’Aquiti a décelé son caractère innovant, témoigné sa confiance et décidé de nous accompagner à chaque tour de table jusqu’à notre introduction en Bourse en 2017. Cela nous a permis d’obtenir nos premières preuves de concept nécessaires et d’accompagner chaque étape de la structuration et du développement de notre Société.

Lorsque nous avons fondé TreeFrog après avoir obtenu l'i-Lab, il était essentiel d'obtenir un financement de démarrage très rapidement afin de maintenir une forte dynamique d'exécution. Grâce à Aquiti nous avons clôturé notre Seed Round en moins de 5 semaines.

En tant que co-fondateur et dirigeant de FineHeart, je tiens à souligner l’importance d’Aquiti. De par la mise à disposition de véhicules de financement variés et très complémentaires (prêt d’honneur aux dirigeants, investissement en capital, soutien et crédibilité auprès des organismes bancaires…) dès la création de l’entreprise, Aquiti apporte un soutien indispensable et répété dans les différentes étapes de notre développement.

Aquiti a joué un rôle crucial dans la réussite d'Activ’inside, apportant un soutien financier et stratégique déterminant. Leur investissement a permis l'acquisition de technologies vertes, minimisant l'empreinte carbone et intégrant des normes environnementales rigoureuses. Ce soutien a également renforcé la crédibilité d'Activ’inside auprès d'autres partenaires et investisseurs.

We are involved at the board level and work directly with management teams on strategic priorities from inception to exit. As a B Corp certified firm, we hold ourselves to the same standards that we expect from our portfolio companies.
We are patient. We do not define a time frame for our investments. Instead, as with all of our actions, we do what is best for the business and its impact.

home: Our fund invests alongside 100+ expert angels. One line on your cap table that brings founders expertise and network.
You get the best of both: hands-on angels to move fast, and a €22M fund that’s got your back.
We’re the first believers in your story, often leading your pre-seed round with the first cheque in
We activate our angel network for intros, advice, sparring and our tailored leadership program: Arches Academy.
You deserve clarity. That’s why we share our terms and processes from day one. So you know exactly where you stand.
We back ambition and stay for the journey.
We invest in Benelux based B2B software startups, typically at the pre-seed stage with ticket sizes between €250K and €1M.

To respect both your time and ours, we start with a short video call. If there’s a fit, we schedule a second meeting with another team member to ensure a balanced view. We might ask for extra details and will always share honest, constructive feedback.

The next step in our process is the Monthly Meeting with our angels. Each month, we host one in-person and one online session where selected startups pitch to our network of Archangels. After your pitch, you’ll have the chance to join informal, face-to-face discussions with investors, where you can validate your business case and receive honest feedback.

We’re fully transparent, our term sheet is available from the start. At Arches, we believe in fair terms. We use standardised documents, trusted by follow-on investors, that keep legal costs low. For many founders, this is the first time dealing with these documents. That’s why we’ve added clear and simple explanations to our term sheet.

about: I started Atelier to fund a specific vision of the world: a world in which people are able to do what they love for a living and to have a more fulfilling and purposeful life.

As an immigrant to the US, I’ve always been captivated by the notion of the American dream and how to broaden access. The Passion Economy thesis is the distillation of that idea: that technology platforms can build a better world, advance economic opportunity, and lower the barriers to entrepreneurship.

I’ve always been a creator: I studied art intensively between age 5 and 18 and have been writing prolifically my entire life. I have immense respect for people who create something from nothing and who make their passion their life’s work.

I fell in love with the divine discontent of founders while investing at Andreessen Horowitz. The act of starting something is to make a statement that we are not, and should not be, content with the way that things are in the world. Founders challenge the status quo by starting a company. As an investor, I have the privilege of supporting them along the way in realizing their visions.
Atelier wouldn’t exist without the support of our investors, mentors, and founders who have believed in me since day 1—for them, I am immensely grateful.

home: Empowering The Next Wave Of Life Science Innovation
We are a leading San Diego biotech venture fund focused on first-in-class innovations to transform patient care.

For over 40 years, Avalon BioVentures has been driving life sciences innovation by investing in and building pioneering biotech companies that address critical unmet medical needs. We don’t just fund companies—we create them. Our team of seasoned entrepreneurs and operators work side-by-side with visionary founders, providing the capital, expertise, mentorship, and infrastructure needed to translate cutting-edge science into breakthrough therapies for patients in need.

We invest in innovative science at the earliest stages, seeking out white space opportunities that are often too early for other investors. We like to be first and do not shy away from scientific risk. From company formation to successful exits, our hands-on approach ensures that each of our companies has the strategic guidance and operational support needed to thrive.

Through our ABV Accelerator, we provide portfolio companies with immediate access to world-class scientific, operational, and financial resources. This fully integrated model expedites development timelines and optimizes capital efficiency, with the goal of rapidly developing potentially life-changing innovations for patients who need them most.

Avalon BioVentures has a long and successful track record of investing in and building life science companies. Our strategy is rooted in identifying and developing disruptive technologies, working closely with world-class scientists, academic institutions, and industry leaders to uncover and translate cutting-edge research into high-impact businesses with the ultimate goal of improving patient outcomes.

At the core of our investment model is the ABV Accelerator; a fully integrated operational and back-office platform designed to maximize efficiency and minimize risk for early-stage biotech startups. By providing access to experienced C-level executives, R&D resources, state-of-the-art lab space, and critical business functions—including finance, HR, and IT—we enable companies to focus on advancing novel therapeutic technologies.

Our investment philosophy is built on experience and execution. Our leadership team, which includes experienced biotech executives and entrepreneurs, plays an active role in portfolio companies—often taking leadership positions, supporting business development, and driving key strategic decisions.

Over the years, we have successfully guided numerous biotech startups from inception to exit, generating billions in transactional value across licensing, M&A, and public market opportunities and thereby delivering potential novel therapies to patients. Our commitment to operational excellence and capital efficiency ensures that every dollar invested is strategically deployed to drive innovation.

At Avalon BioVentures, we believe that the right combination of science, strategy, and execution will deliver innovative medicines. We partner with entrepreneurs who share that vision, working together to deliver breakthrough therapies and improve patient lives worldwide.

about: The biotechnology sector is undergoing a period of unprecedented transformation. The vast need to efficiently address various diseases and to advance novel therapies to remediate unmet medical needs continues to drive innovative approaches by regulators, large pharma and entrepreneurial firms. This activity fosters an environment where large pharma firms are proactively seeking growth opportunities via partnerships and M&A, rendering assets with differentiating characteristics highly valuable.

Our investment team is led by professionals with financial expertise complemented by advanced medical and scientific backgrounds. We aim to capitalize on the opportunity set by actively managing core positions across the sector to maximize the portfolio’s return potential.

Dr. Behzad Aghazadeh, PhD is the Managing Partner and Portfolio Manager of Avoro Capital. He has over 25 years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry spanning scientific research, management consulting, institutional investing, and board leadership.

Behzad received his master’s degree in Physics from the Ludwig-Maximilians-University and a PhD from Cornell University in Biochemistry & Biophysics. He began his career as a research scientist, before joining Booz Allen Hamilton. He has held investment roles at Bernstein Value Equities and Sio Capital Management. Behzad served as the Executive Chairman of Immunomedics, a company developing targeted oncology therapies, from 2017 until the company’s $21B acquisition by Gilead in 2020. He continues to serve on the boards of public and private biotechnology companies.

Neil L Cammarosano is the Chief Financial Officer for Avoro Capital. Prior to joining Avoro in 2024, Neil served as Chief Financial Officer at Bridger Capital LLC. Prior to that, he was Bridger’s Chief Accounting Officer. Neil began his career in PwC’s Asset Management Practice, where he managed the financial statement audits of hedge fund and private equity fund clients. He holds a B.S. in Accounting, magna cum laude and an MBA in Finance from Fordham University. He is a licensed Certified Public Accountant in the State of New York.

Matthew received a BSE in Bioengineering from the University of Pennsylvania and earned his MD/PhD from Harvard Medical School. Matthew completed one year of residency in Clinical Pathology at New York Presbyterian Hospital/Weill Cornell Medicine. His PhD involved development of a CRISPR-based gene therapy approach to sickle cell disease. Matthew joined Avoro Capital in 2019 and is primarily involved in evaluating mid-to-late stage biotechnology investment opportunities.

Diane has over 15 years of Hedge Fund accounting and operations experience. Prior to joining Avoro, Diane spent nine years as Vice President, Assistant Controller of the distressed hedge fund business at Matlin Patterson Global Advisors LLC. Diane began her career at Pricewaterhouse Coopers in the Private Company Services Tax and the Alternatives Assurance practices. Diane holds a B.S. in Finance and Accounting from New York University Stern School of Business and is a Certified Public Accountant in the State of New York. Diane joined Avoro Capital in 2016.

Lauren is responsible for leading Avoro’s investor relations and business development efforts. Prior to joining Avoro in 2024, Lauren served as a Managing Director in Institutional Business Development and Investor Relations at Jennison Associates. Previously, she was Head of Investor Relations at Gotham Asset Management. Lauren began her career at Goldman Sachs Asset Management as a Client Portfolio Manager within the Quantitative Investment Strategies group. She received a BBA, magna cum laude, from the University of Notre Dame and is a CAIA charterholder.

The harsh reality is that most startups will exit through acquisition rather than IPO. We help founders develop business models, product roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies with potential acquirers in mind.
Our deep M&A expertise enables us to anticipate how strategic buyers evaluate acquisition targets — guiding critical decisions from day one.

The M&A process is complex, fast-paced, and emotionally challenging. According to industry experts, "Psychologically, you should prepare yourself for some sort of turmoil. You are operating in a different environment now where your ownership and drive and hustle will likely change."
We help founders navigate the identity shift that comes with exit planning, addressing the psychological barriers that often diminish exit value.
Leading entrepreneurs understand that "psychological preparation can be used to facilitate sensemaking and negotiation" during the acquisition process.

We help founders identify the most likely acquirers years before an exit, guiding strategic decisions that maximize acquisition appeal and building relationships with potential acquirers well in advance of any transaction discussions.

about: The list of exceptional technology companies started or headquartered in Arizona has slowly but steadily grown since our state’s formation in 1912. But our locally-led capital sources have not kept pace with our deal flow, exposing an unnecessary gap in early stage institutional funding for these key economic growth drivers of the Valley. The Arizona Founders Fund is on a mission to close that gap, helping our community’s pioneers of innovation build lasting enterprises. From day one.

To start and scale enterprises, founders need capital. But just as importantly, founders need other founders to join alongside and follow through the process of building those companies. Counsel, referrals, and dig-deep, hands-on support from successful past and present founders is a key part of the strategic value we deliver. In other words, we are more than a seed stage venture capital fund — we are a network of locally-minded founders committed to building world-changing companies.

We will meet every Arizona-based technology startup raising or expecting to raise a seed stage round of financing. We are the first round of capital, writing checks between $50,000 and $400,000. If you are a founder on that journey, we want to meet you.

about: Baseline is an independent community and workspace for early-stage founders who are building breakout and break-through tech companies in Ireland. It's a space where founders can experiment, build velocity, and be plugged into a global network of like-minded founders. We believe that:

As a community of technical, creative, and commercial founders, we share the highs and lows of early stage startup building together. We have high expectations of ourselves, and each other. If someone needs help, we step in and lend a hand, and we should expect the same in return.

Baseline is not operated as a programme, and does not provide mentors. We are not a shared office space, and we don't offer dedicated desks. Our members are self-directed, and value being part of a peer group of like-minded founders, executing with urgency.

We are a community first, workspace second. Baseline is located in the heart of Dublin's Liberties. Our space is comfortable, spacious and designed to be flexible for getting focused or team work done in a mix of open areas and private meeting rooms.

The space is fully air conditioned, with three aspects of daylight, a full kitchen, bike storage, and accessible facilities, including WC's & shower rooms. We're a 24/7, always-on community, and so is the workspace. Members are able to come and go as they please, bring guests, and use the space to host their own events.

Baseline is founded by Fiona Kelly and Eamon Leonard, former founders and angel investors. Fiona works closely with founders on finance, operations, and fundraising. She has built a career on making complex systems feel simple [ LinkedIn ]. Eamon helps founders with product development, go-to-market, and fundraising. He has been building products, leading teams, and creating communities over the past 25 years [ LinkedIn ].

Simultaneously, we are further developing our performance culture.
We have the right playbook to tackle short-term challenges. And, in the long term, we have the right strategy to shape a futureproof BASF.“ Markus Kamieth

We rely on four levers to successfully implement our strategy: Focus, Accelerate, Transform and Win. We are systematically integrating sustainability into our strategy and business as well as into our assessment, steering and compensation systems. This principle is embedded in our corporate purpose: We create chemistry for a sustainable future.
Learn how our strategy sets a clear focus on the management of BASF’s portfolio.

We want to generate value faster by adjusting the way in which we collaborate and get things done at BASF. We are making our organization simpler and leaner by sharpening roles, flattening hierarchies and by reducing bureaucracy. To improve our performance, we will further increase the entrepreneurial freedom of our businesses – and with it their accountability for business success. We are harnessing the potential of AI to advance productivity and accelerate innovation.
Learn how we use artificial intelligence to make our systems more efficient and safer.

We are fully committed to our climate protection targets. The green transformation of our operations and product portfolio is driven by demand from our customer industries. Building on the unique advantages and opportunities of our Verbund, we will increase volumes of renewable, recycled and low-emission feedstocks. Like BASF as a whole, our largest site in Ludwigshafen with its integrated Verbund will benefit from the change and growth momentum connected to the green transformation.

home: We have a passion for supporting emerging technologies led by talented teams. We believe in the Â« fit Â». In the interest of both parties, we are transparent on what we want and let you decide if there is a likely match. If our investment focus doesnât blend with your business model or capital strategy, that means we are simply not meant for each other.

We are passionate about disruptive technologies and the business opportunities that these create. We are looking for innovation pioneers challenging the status quo in traditional sectors, or dramatically improving legacy processes. The companies we fund must have some type of key science or technological innovation leading to the establishment of intellectual property rights.

We invest in enterprise software that is AI-driven, spanning Applied AI & Analytics, customer relationship management (CRM), enterprise resource planning (ERP), and supply chain, with opportunistic investments in cybersecurity and fintech. We also invest in digital-native consumer platforms across sports, wellness, gaming, and entertainment.
We invest primarily in Canadian and US companies. We occasionally invest in companies based in Europe or Israel but those companies must meet an even higher bar.

Traction, growth curve, and unit economics are the most important factors we use to determine specific valuations. Premium valuations would need to be justified with exceptional metrics and technology.

We donât act as lead investor in the first round. We will take a minority position in the first initial round. We will always ask for pro-rata rights to potentially invest in future rounds at larger amounts.
We have a very strong bias towards companies with low cash burns. We also prefer a funding round where our participation usually yields at least 18 months of runway.
Participation in smaller rounds requires companies to have highly disruptive technologies with truly exceptional progress.
We usually require at least two full time founders, with one being technical. We have a strong bias towards startups having strong advisors with shares backing them.

about: Our story started in 2008 when each of us was leading our own business through growth and change. We had sought the wisdom and experience of others and found value in the collective experience and knowledge of three. For different reasons we each sold our businesses to globally-operating and listed entities. Beachhead was formed soon after as our vehicle to pursue what we love – good business ideas backed by passionate and energetic owners.

The three of us bring our own perspectives to each opportunity but we will continue to value our collective judgement rather than a formula. For us to invest, all three must agree. Unlike venture capital funds we use our own capital. This gives us the flexibility to consider each opportunity on its merits rather than imposing artificial benchmarks.

After working in senior roles with global companies in the logistics sector Aaron formed NTS in 2005. It soon found a niche market and grew organically over an 8-year period to a $20m+ business. Now a significant national enterprise, Aaron sold the business to a listed Australian company in 2013.
He continues to operate and consult in the private sector and has driven large changes in corporates that have delivered significant and lasting results for all stakeholders.

Originally an accountant, Aaron understands the importance of keeping a close watch on the financials and has seen many good business falter or fail by placing too much focus on the wrong aspects. He believes it is imperative that all stakeholders in a business are kept firmly accountable and share in the success of a business.
Aaron’s key strengths are operational analysis and continuous improvement. He uses intuition and solid financial skills to get to the heart of any business.
Alan is passionate about technology, innovation and change as it applies to any facet of life. He enjoys business, inspiring and transforming teams.
He is a successful entrepreneur in the technology services sector with a deep understanding of technology trends and markets having built and exited several technology businesses.

home: Beachhead is a venture capital firm investing in high-growth Australian companies looking to rapidly expand, go further and achieve more.
We are an early stage venture capital firm backing exceptional Australian entrepreneurs. We help you with capital, guidance and strategy.
The value we bring is our willingness to take on risk and guide you through the fast-changing environment of growth. Ideally this would prepare you for Series A capital raise or an exit.

Our strengths come from hands-on experience in starting, growing and exiting businesses across a number of industries. We understand the effort and risk you are taking, and offer more than being a silent partner on the sidelines. We prefer to invest in businesses that offer a unique advantage to outcompete established rivals. We are agnostic to industry sector with a focus on scalable unit economics.
There is nothing that drives us more than success – your success.
“ I have a knack for spotting an opportunity that others miss . ”
“ I love the power of smart ideas and good people creating seriously good businesses. ”
“Building something from nothing and challenging the status quo have always been my passion. ”
We seek early stage businesses with the passion and ideas to go all the way. We are looking for people with self-belief, perseverance and some rat cunning.

If it is only money you need, we're probably not the right partner for you. We are looking for early-stage businesses that are looking for both money and where we have an edge to develop their business into something of much greater value. The majority of our investments will be in the $200k- to $1m range where the business already has a product, team and, most importantly, customers.

about: If Alex was asked why did you choose the profession of a venture investor? He would answer: What else could I do? Sometimes you have to stop thinking so much and go where your heart takes you. We believe that Alex’s heart is somewhere between AI and Software, albeit his soul and body actively approaching FoodTech. :o:

Alex is not able to sit still and wait for new opportunities, but proactively creates them. For 15 years in private equity and venture capital investments, he took part in more than 50 transactions with a total volume of over $3.5 billion. Alex's strengths include: structuring deals, finding new opportunities, finance, strategy and sales.

To charm Alex, the project needs strong and unique leaders, tested and digitized hypotheses, and a vision of the team on a long horizon (Alex's planning horizon is rumored to be the longest in history). Unlike most VCs, Alex loves to read long letters and study detailed decks from the founders.
Alex is passionate about Begin and our portfolio 24/7, except when his favorite football team is playing. But we are very lucky that they lose all the time and have few matches per year.

Before dedicating his life to venture capital Ruslan tried himself in all other roles: startup founder, corporate and strategy consultant. Now, two facts he knows for sure: “VC is the best job in the world” and “being a startup founder is awesome, but freaking hard!”

To make founders’ life somewhat easier Ruslan is always happy to share his experience. From building sales teams in US and China to raising $50m+ investment rounds. Prior to Begin Ruslan spent 5 years with Runa Capital where he worked with awesome startups like Mambu, NGINX, and Brainly.

Ruslan is passionate about partnering with entrepreneurs who are focused on building product-driven companies and share Ruslan’s love of excel. You can melt his heart with deep industry knowledge and 5-years product plan.

If you can’t reach out to Ruslan, it is probably because he got lost while exploring jungles in India or national parks in Africa. He also used to sail the ocean and freeride in mountains, but his skills were so poor that his wife wisely banned all life threatening activities.

home: A VC fund is very similar to a TV series. Each investment is a new episode in which founders are actors and investment managers are the casting directors. If the series is successful then there will be a season two.
Alex and Ruslan are sceptical about horror and drama in the investment portfolio, but always looking for a next blockbuster. Reach out to them if you are shooting one.

The first investment season for Begin Capital started in 2020. We invested in 28 blockbusters across all industries and genres. We have led and participate in Seed and Series A rounds with checks from $500k up to $7M. There are no geographic borders for a real hit, but the European market is close to our heart.

The second season of Begin Capital will be dedicated to the world of DeepTech, Artificial Intelligence and the Physical World. Our investment thesis equally values both – mind-blowing technology backend as well as proven industry applications. We'll support the most innovative and ambitious teams from the early days to help them reach singularity :o: With strong advisors on board and love of science fiction, the second casting is open for new applications
We have a global mandate and invest at Pre-seed to Series A stage. Our ticket size is flexible, ranging from $500K to $8M

People are behind every revolution. And we are looking for exceptional founders who are Pirates, Winners and Robots. Pirates . We are looking for founders who are not afraid to make a mistake and always ready to challenge the rules. We call them “Pirates”. Winners . Small goals are not for us. Founders who work with us, always want to conquer the world. Nothing less. We call them “Winners”. Robots . Building a business is hard. Founders shall have a clear understanding of all business processes and be rigorously improving every KPI. Day after day. We call them “Robots”.

Unique ideas are capable of disrupting markets. But we prefer to treat all ideas as hypotheses. And we only invest in hypotheses that are tested and translatable into numbers. Numbers help us make informative and responsible investment decisions. We also believe that no unicorn was built without great attention to the numbers (except for Theranos) :o::o::o:

“Partner” is not just a title for us. In good times and bad, we put the startup’s interests above our own. We' re proud to be partners with founders and encourage close communication with our portfolio.
We're building a new VC fund and consider ourselves entrepreneurs. We want Begin Capital to be the #1 choice for founders and are excited about the work we do every day.
We see our mission is sharing knowledge and experience with our portfolio companies. And if our expertise is not enough, we will find the best experts to help.

about: Behold Venture is a specialist operated fund. All of us on the investment team have spend our careers dedicated to the games industry, making and publishing games, starting new companies, leading and growing existing ones.

We’ve worked on AAA franchises with several hundreds devs, and we’ve helped indie games go to market. In this wide range of experiences there’s one common, red thread through all our journeys - and it’s not only our love for interactive entertainment - but our true interest in the people actually making the games!

Karl Magnus, or KM as most in the Nordics call him, is a game developer and studio leader turned investor. After two decades of building and leading award-winning AAA teams and managing global groups of game studios at companies like DICE and EA , he switched to early-stage investments in 2016. As a private investor he invested in 18 different start-ups before starting Behold Ventures.

Sigurlína, also known as Lina, is an Icelandic engineer and game producer, who after a 15-year stint spanning five cities in four countries in leadership roles on franchises like EVE Online, The Division, Star Wars Battlefront and FIFA has shifted her focus to Behold and investing in early-stage companies.

Magnus has a background as a strategy consultant and corporate finance professional. The last 10 years was spent as the founding partner of Sequent Invest (small cap private equity). Magnus also co-founded several start-ups and has served on the board of numeral companies, most relevant Fast Track Capital and Mionix. In addition, Magnus has made some 20+ business angel investment.

Brynjólfur, commonly known as Binni, is an Icelandic computer scientist and experienced analytics and research leader with 15 years of experience in the game industry. He has played a key role in initiating and leading analytics and research for game franchises such as Minecraft, Toca Boca, Battlefield, EVE Online, The Hunter: Call Of The Wild and Crusader Kings, among many others.

Ali Farha is a senior producer and tech leader with 10+ years of experience. He played a key role in porting Star Stable Online to multiple platforms and is an active voice in the games industry ecosystem.
“We’Ve put together a world-class group of endemic Experts AND ADVISORS, creatING an unparalleled opportunity for our portfolio companies to evolve and grow.”

home: Behold Ventures is a venture capital fund, laser-focused on enabling the next generation of game entrepreneurs by calling upon the experiences of the current one. Lifelong commitments to the games industry - as developers, publishers, studio leaders and investors – are now ready to stand by and support new endeavors.

The generations of today favor video games over all other forms of media. Almost half of the entire population of earth play video games and have an active relationship with this form of interactive entertainment - and we’re just getting started.

At Behold, we strongly believe that video games truly are the medium of our century. They are changing how we communicate, interact and relate for the better. Seeing this bright future is a big reason why we invest in video games.

We’re big on people. Behind every idea, vision and daring new venture we always find passionate individuals who in some way want to achieve greatness, fulfill dreams or make a change. The core of these people is of mighty importance to us, and we keep looking for sound values and a true north which aligns much with our own.

In the same way, as we and other investors grill the entrepreneurs on every single detail of their plan, we always encourage them to do the reverse due diligence and pressure test anyone they consider letting onto their cap table. Early-stage investments are much more than cold transactions, it’s like setting out on a long journey together - and the travel company needs to be picked wisely.
“VIDEO GAMES TRULY ARE THE MEDIUM OF THE 20th CENTURY, AND THEY ARE EVOLVING HOW WE INTERACT AS A SPECIES.”

At Behold Ventures, we invest in early-stage video game start-ups founded by ambitious and creative founders with an aptitude for strategic thinking. We look for teams that are hellbent on creating the most amazing entertainment experiences of tomorrow.
We then make it our mission to support, further inspire and multiply the star potential in all of them.

about: Generate returns for our investors while serving the early stage capital needs of women-led companies generating social or environmental impact.

Women-led companies are the fastest growing sector of new companies. We serve every aspect of this growth, creating jobs and opportunities for women and positive impacts on the economy and role models for women. We provide early stage investing, a network of successful and connected women, and experienced leadership and operations support.

We are successful entrepreneurs and executives with experience in diverse markets, proven operating experience and contacts at global companies. We seek to provide a trusting, learning environment for investors and founders alike, and to encourage more women to become early stage investors.
General Partner, Co-Founder of BELLE Funds

Our objective is to achieve capital appreciation and an above average rate of return for investors. Post investment, we roll up our sleeves to help our portfolio companies prepare for high value exits by working closely with founders and senior management to achieve rapid growth and profitability.

Our fund focuses on primarily women-owned or managed privately held seed and early-stage growth businesses in the digital, mobile, cloud technology, life sciences, medical device and advanced manufacturing and alternative energy spaces with a preference given to companies located in underserved geographic markets. We’re looking for coachable entrepreneurs with deep domain or industry experience.

We’re particularly interested in disruptive technology, first to market start-ups and other businesses displaying industry innovation and the ability to disrupt the relevant market. Special consideration is given to companies requiring relatively small amounts of capital and/or debt for sustainability/liquidity.

We prefer to lead or co-lead early stage preferred rounds. We typically invest between $25K to $250K in tranches tied to achievement of milestones and reserve up to 25% of committed capital for follow-on investments. We frequently syndicate with other funds to help our portfolio companies raise necessary capital. Our fund structure streamlines our decision-making process and helps companies get access to their capital quickly.

Benson Oak bought AVG in 2004 when it was a 20 person team in Brno, Czech Republic and became actively involved in assisting the management of the Company. At the time, AVG had $5M in revenue but had just started to offer its anti-virus product for free.

Benson Oak became involved in the operations and especially in developing the freemium model as the company grew to over 100 million users, becoming a global leader in Internet Security solutions for consumers and small businesses. In 2005, Enterprise Investors and Intel Capital bought into AVG in a secondary transaction and in 2009, TA Associates entered. Overall, BOCs investment in AVG returned 100x to its investors as the company exceeded a $1 billion market cap after going public on the NYSE in February 2012.

Robert Cohen spearheaded BOC’s acquisition of AVG and was deeply involved in the business for the next 8 years. Aside from being a Board member, Robert also served as interim CFO, managed AVG’s fund raising activities.

In 2011, he joined the senior management team responsible for global M&A and strategic corporate development activity and gained deep operational experience via the execution and integration of five acquisitions and two strategic partnerships, in the US, Germany and Israel. Robert was part of the management team as it went public.

about: 新卒で大手SIerに入社。経営コンサルティング会社、独立を経て、オプト（現、株式会社デジタルホールディングス）にジョイン。新規事業開発、グループ経営企画、M&Aの責任者を歴任。2013年に投資育成事業の立ち上げ、2015年にオプトベンチャーズ（現、Bonds Investment Group株式会社）を立ち上げる。2022年独立し、スタートアップエコシステムによる日本の革新をテーマとしたBIG Impact株式会社を設立、始動。
『Forbes Japan』が選ぶ「日本で最も影響力のあるベンチャー投資家ランキング BEST10」2018年第3位、2020年第5位に選出される。主な実績、ラクスル、グノシー、ジーニー、ジモティー、rakumo、ウェルスナビ。

韓国政府系機関で主に海外要人対応業務に携わる。その後、米系大手会計事務所アーンスト・アンド・ヤング・ジャパンでPMI（Post Merger Integration）の業務に携わった後、オプトベンチャーズ（現Bonds Investment Group）にジョイン。 投資業務の他、国内外の市場調査、産業分析、海外事例分析等を経験。その後、PPB インターナショナル株式会社を設立。過去のクロスボーダー取引経験を生かし、シリコンバレーや海外のスタートアップの日本進出、及び国内スタートアップの海外進出を支援。

大学在学中にミズノ株式会社の新規事業部にて、 新規事業プログラムの設計/運営を経験。 その後、新規事業開発を支援する会社に所属し、自社事業の推進や名古屋拠点の副拠点長として事業支援/創出を推進。 Relicでは2023年のMVP等の社内表彰なども複数受ける。 2024年に報酬型長期インターンに特化したBibles株式会社を創業。 BIG Impact株式会社には2023年にベンチャーパートナーとして所属。

学を主席且つ飛び級で卒業し、AIやITの知識技術を極めるために大学院に入学。 大学院卒業後は、大手通信会社のCEO室で自社の成長戦略のためのデータ分析および戦略を担当。 その後、外資系コンサルファームにてAIやWeb3関連の事業戦略立案を担当し、独立。 フリーランスとして様々な企業のWebアプリ開発およびシステム実装/要件整理における幅広いITコンサルを担当。 2023年経産省の高度IT人材として石川県加賀市の企業のDX化を推進。

近畿大学薬学部卒。薬剤師。 在学中にNEWRON株式会社を創業。健康食品の開発と、都心薬剤師を地方薬局に派遣する「旅する薬剤師」という地方創生事業を運営。学生起業経験を元に、大阪府や堺市など、行政の起業家育成プログラムなどを運営。 近畿大学経営学部非常勤講師。ワークショップ形式で社会課題解決型ビジネスの創り方などを指導。 2025年弊社ジョイン。主に関西・神戸におけるネットワーキング、ソーシングを担当。

早稲田大学のMBAを取得後、大手VCにて投資及びファンドマネジメントに従事。2014年にオプト（現、デジタルホールディングス）入社後、投資及びオプトベンチャーズ（現、Bonds Investment Group）立ち上げを経て、スタートアップの創業メンバー・CFOとして事業創出・経営を行う。事業会社にてオープンイノベーション戦略を担った後、2018年にオプトベンチャーズ（現、Bonds Investment Group）に再参画。 2022年独立し、スタートアップエコシステムによる日本の革新をテーマとしたBIG Impact株式会社を創業。

1976年千葉県生まれ。千葉東高校、早稲田大学法学部卒。2000年、東日本電信電話(株)入社。主に法人営業企画、プロモーション等を担当。2006年、株式会社フォトクリエイトに参画。一貫して新規事業、広報、採用に従事。国内外企業とのアライアンス実績多数。2013年7月、同社にて東証マザーズ上場を経験。 2014年1月に株式会社スペースマーケットを創業。2016年1月、シェアリングエコノミーの普及と業界の健全な発展を目指すシェアリングエコノミー協会を設立し代表理事に就任（現在理事）。2019年12月、東証マザーズに上場。

Desde 2012 trabajamos en etapas iniciales con emprendedores extraordinarios de diferentes sectores. Estamos orgullosos de los estrechos vínculos que hemos ido forjando a lo largo del camino.
Invertimos en fases iniciales, nos comprometemos personalmente y hacemos equipo con emprendedores excepcionales para ayudar a construir grandes empresas

Para nosotros, las fases iniciales significan invertir en empresas con el potencial de convertirse en líderes globales, pero que aún están dando los primeros pasos de su desarrollo, así participando en la creación de valor que implica desarrollar y escalar un nuevo negocio basado en tecnología. Por lo general, esto se refiere a la etapa inicial (semilla), pero abarcamos desde Pre-semilla hasta la serie A.

Invertimos en dos temáticas: Poder de Internet: Invertimos en productos y servicios habilitados por la tecnología: El software, internet y la tecnología de la información son nuestro núcleo Deep Tech: Cuántica, Inteligencia Artificial, Materiales, Fotónica, Microelectrónica, Nanotecnología... para ofrecer soluciones a desafíos globales en energía, descarbonización, población, movilidad...

Big Sur invierte en compañías innovadoras con productos y servicios rompedores que prometen aportar beneficios transformadores a un mercado. Buscamos proyectos excepcionales que puedan cambiar la estructura del mercado.

Nuestro objetivo es ayudarte a crear una gran empresa. Por este motivo, nuestra inversión va acompañada de nuestro compromiso e implicación personal. Estamos orgullosos de nuestra trayectoria inversora y de las estrechas relaciones que formamos con los equipos fundadores. ‍ Pero no hace falta que nos creas, habla con los fundadores de las empresas de nuestro portfolio.
Si tienes un proyecto disruptivo, queremos que nos lo cuentes.

about: Energy, food, factories, biology — these are the systems that sustain human life and they have been running on legacy infrastructure stretched to its limits.

AI spent its first decade behind glass, making our digital lives more responsive. That was the opening act. What comes next is harder, more consequential, and represents the largest technology shift of our lifetimes: intelligence moving into the physical world itself.
Bison invests in this frontier of technology – where AI collides with the physical economy.
It’s not a niche vertical or a passing fad. It’s a $60 trillion opportunity across the global economy.

We partner with the founders reimagining the ways we build, move, and heal as well as the energy and compute innovations that underpin it all. We look for the most ambitious entrepreneurs building non-incremental businesses at the frontier of technology and who share our vision of the future.

Navigating this opportunity requires a team of specialized generalists that both understand technology as well as the nuanced market dynamics of real world industries. We’re all engineers at Bison and we bring deep experience from helping entrepreneurs build these types of businesses through multiple cycles and across 20+ unicorns.

We know where legacy systems are failing, and where a well-designed intelligent layer changes everything. More food grown with less. Diseases caught earlier and treated faster. Infrastructure that holds together under pressure.

The companies we back don't just sit on top of physical industries. They grow into them, becoming load-bearing parts of how those industries function. By backing businesses that are genuinely necessary, we capture the explosive growth of software alongside the enduring staying power of industry.
bison.vc.desc: Bison Ventures is a venture capital firm that invests in early-stage frontier technology companies focused on creating healthier people and a healthier planet.
home: We partner with founders pushing the frontier of intelligence to build, heal, and power the physical world.
Pre-seed to Series B $1M to $15M investments
AI is transforming the way physical products are made and moved.

AI is transforming the way physical products are made and moved. From creating better software tools for design and validation to building intelligent manufacturing platforms that affordably re-onshore production to novel systems that more efficiently transport both people and goods. The next chapter of industry will embrace autonomy and general purpose robotics in a way that makes supply chains more resilient and enables the next industrial (r)evolution.
Humans are living longer than ever, but much of biology is still a mystery.

Humans are living longer than ever, but much of biology is still a mystery. Expanding our understanding requires new experimental platforms - physical and digital - that identify biological breakthroughs and new ways of translating discoveries into the next generation of therapies. Closing the loop and bending the curve on human health will also require more effective healthcare delivery for both the body and mind.
The most critical resources today are minerals, electrons, and transistors.

The most critical resources today are minerals, electrons, and transistors. In a world that is trying to go bigger and faster, we believe the right question is: how do we do more with less? This requires orders of magnitude improvements in how critical metals are discovered and extracted, how new materials are invented and commercialized, how energy is produced and delivered, and how efficiently chips turn tokens into real world intelligence.
Allonnia uses computationally-designed and engineered micro-organisms to sustainably increase the production of critical metals for uses in electrification, AI, and re-onshoring of manufacturing.
Bonsai builds general purpose autonomy for offroad environments. The company’s world model and autonomy stack improves productivity and reduces costs across agriculture, mining, and construction.

We are entering the largest reallocation of human time, attention, and purpose in history.

Every major leap in civilization has followed the same pattern: agriculture freed us from foraging, industrialization from subsistence, the internet from information scarcity. Each time, human energy was reallocated toward higher-order pursuits — and the industries that shaped that reallocation defined their era.

AI and robotics can already automate more than half of all work hours in the United States — not as a projection, but with technologies that exist today. When AI handles the process of work, humanity can choose what is worth pursuing.

In mehr als 15 Berufsjahren sammelte Kai Panitzki vielfältige Erfahrungen und Know-how als Unternehmer und Experte vor allem im Technologie- und Finanz-Sektor.

Nach einer klassischen Ausbildung zum Bankkaufmann und Juristen begann Kai seine Karriere als Redakteur bei Deutschlands größtem Anlegermagazin „Der Aktionär“, wo er wertvolle Einblicke in die Finanzmärkte gewann. Darüber hinaus knüpfte er intensive Kontakte in die Venture Capital Szene hinein.

1999 wechselte er als Projektleiter zur BBDO-Tochter „Sponsor Partners“ nach Bonn. Bereits ein Jahr später gründete er eine eigene Kommunikationsagentur, aus der 2007 „Scholz & Friends Düsseldorf“ hervorging, die Kai bis Januar 2013 führte. Parallel dazu gründete er 2007 ein Unternehmen für Presse- und Socialmedia-Monitoring, die „X-Ray PMD GmbH“ und verkaufte dieses 2009 vollständig an Scholz & Friends.

2013 wurde Kai Vorstand der Börsenmedien AG, Herausgeber unter anderem des Anlegermagazins „Der Aktionär“. Im Rahmen seiner Vorstandstätigkeit übernahm Kai verschiedene Aufsichtsrats- und Beiratsmandate, die er zum Teil bis heute weiter führt. 2015 wurde er Vorstand der börsennotierten Finlab AG.
Wenn Kai nicht gerade spannende Deals verhandelt, widmet er sich mit Begeisterung der Familie, dem Wassersport und dem Lesen vieler Bücher (meist auf dem Kindle).

These days, you can do just about anything online—even visit your doctor. So why do you still need to drive across town just to get someone to notarize a document?

That compelling question spurred co-founders Pat Kinsel and Adam Pase to launch Notarize, a firm that—with the help of Camber Creek—is bringing online document verification to some of the largest companies in the world.
Through Notarize, consumers and businesses can connect with an online notary public 24-7 using a computer, tablet, or smartphone.
Of course, achieving scale meant Notarize needed to work with major businesses and other digital products. That’s why Camber Creek:

“Camber Creek has been an amazing partner for us,” Pat says. “From their presence on our board to helping us land major partnerships with leading real estate groups and corporations like Adobe, they’ve been tremendous.”

Now known as Proof, notarization is one of the solutions the company offers. Proof is adding layers of trust to online transactions with products that use a combination of human and digital verification to give all parties assurance. Their software provides an effective counter against the range of tools available to falsify financial records, income, and even identity.

home: Droia invests globally in young drug development companies that use novel science and innovative approaches to bring promising therapies to patients. We are specialists, investing exclusively in therapeutics for oncology and genetic disease.

Our focus and our in-house team of drug development experts and biotech professionals allow us to accelerate our companies’ progress by actively supporting them from company creation through clinical proof of concept. We are hands-on investors and entrepreneurs, fully dedicated to making an impact and saving patient lives.

For biotech companies, ultimate success is measured in effective patient benefit. Promising therapies should have a material impact on patient prognosis, measured as a function of the severity of the unmet medical need addressed and the improvement in therapeutic benefits as compared to (expected) standard of care.

We only invest in companies that are able, through their technology platforms or scientific insights, to go after previously unsolvable clinical problems. Companies should differentiate not only by way of innovation, but also in the way this innovation translates to clinical breakthrough.

Droia actively scouts for the best science and the best teams. Whether investing in an existing company or creating a new company, we actively participate in our portfolio companies’ development . Our team has deep and specialized experience in disease biology, translational science, clinical development and company building.

We have built many companies from the ground up, supporting and complementing founders and management teams. Our team members dedicate their time to helping their companies, and will take on interim roles within companies to help them get off the ground faster. Our whole organization is geared towards doing what we do best: building great drug development companies.

home: Partnering with the most ambitious founders building the future energy system

We believe the future of energy will be defined by electrification and orchestration. As economies replace fuel-based systems with renewable electricity, energy becomes increasingly interconnected across power, transport, buildings, industry, and digital infrastructure.

This transition creates a more dynamic and complex energy system. Electric vehicles become flexible grid assets; buildings become both consumers and producers of energy; industrial processes become increasingly electrified and digitally controlled. As renewable generation scales, the ability to forecast, optimise, store, transport, and coordinate energy becomes as important as producing it. Technologies such as AI, advanced software, and digital infrastructure play a critical role in enabling this coordination.

Creating this new energy future requires bold thinking and new business models. Future Energy Ventures exists to accelerate that transition by investing in the platforms, intelligence, and technologies that enable electrified energy systems to operate efficiently at scale. We partner with founders building solutions that help manage complexity, improve resilience, and unlock new sources of value across the energy ecosystem.

Future Energy Ventures is rooted in the energy industry, but we recognise that the future energy system extends far beyond traditional sector boundaries. Its success depends on collaboration between energy, mobility, industry, buildings, and digital technology. That is why we invest in companies that sit at these intersections, helping create an energy system that is more productive, resilient, and sustainable.
We back companies accelerating the shift to an electrified, software-defined energy system.

We invest in asset-light, scalable businesses—often at the intersection of energy and digital infrastructure—that unlock efficiency, flexibility, and new market structures. Our sweet spot is Series A+ companies with proven product–market fit, clear customer demand, and a model that can scale rapidly across geographies.
We look for founders who understand the complexity of energy markets and have the conviction to transform them

We provide our portfolio companies with funding, mentoring and connections to accelerate their growth trajectory via our network of highly committed partners and our integrated collaboration platform.

about: Forbion is a leading global venture capital firm with deep expertise in Europe. about: Updated January 2026 As we type our letter, we are already on the hunt for the next vertical singularities. For the founders that became enthralled with such a singularity, and the appetite to build a legendary vertical firm. This is our letter to them.

We founded Foundamental in January 2019 with a thesis, a prior track record, and $60 million in commitments. Five years later Foundamental grows to more than $300 million. As of late 2025, and our third fund, we are flush with the available financial air power to back and cover the most ambitious builders, starting at their day zero.
More than ever, our minds are locked on our search for those who build the next 100 legendary technology companies in the project-based world. They build from the ground up, we bring the air power.

Before Foundamental, its founders had collected a spectrum of experiences across technology, venture, and industrial operations. At our day zero, we looked to some like a random mash-up of our prior successes as investors, engineers, executives and business builders across the heavy industries of energy, chemicals, building materials, automotive and elevators. We, however, felt like the obvious team to build the pre-eminent vertical technology investment firm for the project-based sectors that (re) build our world, due to our unique takes and putting in the work.

Today, the Foundamental team is composed of a dozen unique individuals who expanded our spectrum of experiences and perspectives. All of us coming together to form our unique and controversial takes on technology for the project-based world. Which is powered by our past lives.

As a result, Foundamental’s approach is not to invest in common wisdoms and herd heuristics. Herd heuristics are a force of nature that allows mankind to make sense of the world in highly repetitive situations. The issue with applying herd heuristics is that legendary companies do not repeat. Each has its own unique ingredients.

Our starting point, therefore, is to search for vertical singularities in our project-based sectors, almost always invisible or hard to evaluate until they become obvious later for others who, unlike us, are not set up to spend 365 days a year in our markets.

When we find such vertical singularities, we spend the time on details to build a deep-rooted conviction in those opportunities that most overlook initially. Like the founders we back, we believe that building Foundamental into a legendary technology investment firm therefore requires focus and dedication.

Risk summary for non-readily realisable securities which are shares:
Last updated: 15 April 2024 | Estimated reading time: 2 min
1. You could lose all the money you invest
If the business you invest in fails, you are likely to lose 100% of the money you invested. Most start-up businesses fail.
2. You are unlikely to be protected if something goes wrong

The business offering this investment is not regulated by the FCA. Protection from the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) only considers claims against failed regulated firms. Learn more about FSCS protection here .

Protection from the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) does not cover poor investment performance. If you have a complaint against an FCA-regulated firm, FOS may be able to consider it. Learn more about FOS protection here .
3. You won’t get your money back quickly

Even if the business you invest in is successful, it may take several years to get your money back. You are unlikely to be able to sell your investment early. The most likely way to get your money back is if the business is bought by another business or lists its shares on an exchange such as the London Stock Exchange. These events are not common. If you are investing in a start-up business, you should not expect to get your money back through dividends. Start-up businesses rarely pay these.

about: Larsen Jensen is the Founder and Managing General Partner of Harpoon Ventures, a $300M AUM venture capital firm specializing in early-stage technology companies. At Harpoon, Larsen has built the firm from the ground up, raising three funds and investing in dozens of high-profile startups in a variety of sectors.

Prior to founding Harpoon, Larsen gained venture experience at Andreessen Horowitz and Lightspeed Venture Partners, where he supported early-stage companies across various sectors. His journey into venture capital was preceded by a role in Goldman Sachs’ Principal Investment Area (PIA) within its Merchant Banking Division, focusing on private equity and growth-stage investing.

Larsen served as a U.S. Navy SEAL for six years, deploying on combat operations in Afghanistan. He is a combat-decorated veteran whose military service reflects a commitment to mission success and leadership under pressure. The skills he honed in the SEAL Teams—teamwork, strategic thinking, and resilience—now inform his work with founders and portfolio companies.

Before his military career, Larsen was one of the most accomplished American distance swimmers in history. A two-time Olympic medalist (2004 Athens, 2008 Beijing), he still holds the American record in the 400m freestyle. At the height of his career, he simultaneously held the American records in the 400m, 800m, and 1500m freestyle events.

Larsen earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Southern California, where he also gained early financial experience working at UBS and Citizens Business Bank. After leaving the Navy, he pursued his MBA at Stanford Graduate School of Business to further refine his skills in leadership and investing.
When not working with founders or portfolio companies, Larsen spends his time with his family and stays connected to his roots by socializing, working out, and training, with former Navy teammates.

about: Helen Ltd is the market leader in Finland’s electricity sales, committed to making everyday life easier and more effortless for customers throughout the country. We are responsible for the production and distribution of district heating and district cooling in Helsinki, while also providing solutions for regional and renewable energy. We are systematically reducing our emissions by developing a smarter energy system, with the goal of achieving net-zero emissions and phasing out combustion-based energy production by 2040.

The Customers and services business unit provides electricityrelated services to consumers, housing companies and businesses. The business activities of the Customers and services unit are mainly focused on electricity contracts, in addition to which it offers flexibility and other value-added services.

Heating and cooling produces, distributes and sells heating and cooling in the Helsinki region. The focus of its business activities is on developing heating and cooling through investing in, and building, new production capacity. about: What gets built decides the next decade.
Reindustrializing America is one of our primary objectives. This is the argument, and the companies behind it.
For a generation, the efficient answer was to design here and build elsewhere. The cost of that answer now shows up in supply chains, in the power grid and in the defense industrial base.

The new builders are not rebuilding the old factories. They write software first and use it to run the plant, the reactor, the aircraft and the data center. That produces companies with the learning curve of software and the staying power of heavy industry.

We think this is among the most important investment themes of the next decade. We invest in it deliberately: in companies that add real capacity, sell to customers who need it, and are led by people who have shipped hard things before.
Three theses organize everything we do: power, defend, secure.
Intelligence is now an industrial product.
AI needs land, electricity, chips and steel before it needs anything else. We back the companies that supply them, on the ground and in orbit, on the timeline the buildout demands.

about: K9 Ventures is a technology-focused Pre-Seed fund in Palo Alto, California.

K9 Ventures is a technology focused Pre-Seed fund based in Palo Alto, California. We believe that extraordinary things are possible when great teams come together around technology. We primarily invest at the pre-seed stage, when the founding team is established and just starting to build the product, but we sometimes invest even earlier and have engaged with founders when they’re just thinking about the idea and haven’t yet incorporated their company.

K9 wants to be the first institutional / professional capital raised by the companies we invest in. This means we typically engage with companies either when they have raised no capital at all (preferred) or when they have raised only friends and family money. If a company is going through an incubator / accelerator, then that’s probably already too late for K9 to engage.

Our initial investment can range between $250K and $750K, with the sweet-spot being around $400K. We prefer to lead investment rounds, and when we do, K9 will take a board seat and actively work with the founder(s) to build the company. To provide sufficient attention to each portfolio company, K9 only invests in 4-6 companies per year. We structure all our investments as priced equity rounds based on the Series Seed documents (or the more recent fork at Cooley Go ) and do not do Convertible Notes /SAFEs. To learn more, please see our investment criteria .

VC firms love to talk about how important they are to their portfolio companies’ success. We don’t believe in singing our own praises. If you want to learn how we’ve helped entrepreneurs like you, we encourage you to talk to startup founders in the K9 portfolio .
Our view is that money is a commodity in the venture capital industry and the only two currencies that matter are reputation and time . With that in mind, our four guiding values are:
To get to know us better, please read our blog — we’re open with our opinions and and consistent in our views.

Dogs have many traits that can be useful at different times. They can be your best friend; they can be loyal and loving, aggressive and intelligent. Startups require different forms of support at different times. If dogs are “man’s best friend,” you can think of K9 Ventures as the “startup’s best friend.”

about: OrbiMed is a global investment firm that invests in companies engaged in the discovery and development of biopharmaceutical products, medical technologies, medical devices, diagnostics, drug discovery tools, and healthcare information technology and services companies.

The global healthcare industry sits at the intersection of several powerful long-term growth trends led by global demographics and the ineluctable advance of scientific innovation in treating disease.

These trends have caused a steady increase in the level of healthcare spending in the industrialized world, led by the U.S. which now spends over 17% of its GDP on healthcare. We believe the healthcare industry’s powerful growth profile coupled with its magnitude and complexity create myriad investment opportunities.

OrbiMed invests across the global healthcare industry, from seed-stage venture capital to large publicly-traded companies. Investments are made in one of three strategies: public equity, private equity, and private credit/royalty.

OrbiMed's private equity strategy is broad and flexible, investing from start-ups through growth equity. OrbiMed is typically a lead investor, helping to build our portfolio companies into market leaders. We invest globally, including across North America, Asia, and Europe.

OrbiMed provides commercial-stage healthcare companies with non-dilutive structured debt capital. Additionally, OrbiMed can monetize royalty streams, providing valuable financing solutions to owners of intellectual property.

OrbiMed manages a series of public equity funds, including long/short event-driven funds and closed-end investment trusts. We invest across all types of publicly-traded companies, from biopharmaceuticals to medical devices and healthcare services worldwide.

To thrive, organisms need to adapt and grow. So do investment firms. Through 25 years of volatile, changing investment environments, we've embraced new opportunities and expanded our global footprint.
